findings.location: Technical Context Constraints; ID-R04, ID-I05, ID-S03, ID-X04 and Unresolved Dependencies item 7
findings.affected_requirement: O-NFR01 denial of arbitrary host files and writes; FR-010 unchanged prepared source/config/hooks; AD-3 separation of canonical source and tool state
findings.evidence: The October epics define O-NFR01 as denying arbitrary host files and writes. The revised plan states that direct CodeGraph children inherit host filesystem/network rights and have no effective write barrier beyond the application’s intended `.codegraph` grant. The user’s instruction rejects an AppContainer profile and Windows-specific checked-in harness but does not explicitly amend O-NFR01 or FR-010. The direct Git/no-Git evidence observed only in-fixture `.codegraph` additions and unchanged fixture files; it explicitly leaves external writes, network activity, effective child confinement and application-bound behavior unverified. Closed stdin and environment flags reduce known optional effects but cannot establish the required denial. The plan’s own item 7 recognizes this unresolved authority interpretation while its Constitution Check claims no exception.
findings.correction_outcome: Resolve the requirement disposition before accepting this route: either define a direct-process boundary that demonstrably denies arbitrary host file/write access while honoring the user’s no-AppContainer/no-Windows-harness choice, or obtain an explicit authorized PRD/architecture change that narrows the preventive O-NFR01 obligation and reconcile the spec, plan and qualification claims. Preserve the observed fixture result as limited evidence and keep Story 18.2, reader, native-result and application-bound holds. Do not infer a waiver from the user’s process preference or mark source immutability proven from fixture manifests.

summary: The seven hashes and canonical digest match the pinned boundary; read-only deterministic plan validation returned no errors. Prior PR-18-3-01, PR-18-3-02 and DR-18-3-01 remain resolved at their respective reviewed boundaries. The direct controlled fixtures provide useful CLI/native transport and local write-footprint evidence, but the revised process design expressly lacks denial of arbitrary host file writes required by O-NFR01. The user’s direct-process decision does not itself amend that requirement. No task artifact was reviewed, and no Story 18.2 or application-bound capability was inferred.
